data.body: **[P2] Observe retry progress before checking for duplicate bodies.** `WRAPPER_ENTER` precedes execution of any steps. This predicate can succeed before the second invocation reaches `success`, so the subsequent body count remains one even if the retry later repeats that step. Teardown can also stop it before duplication occurs. Wait for the second request's `BLOCKED` or `EFFECT` event from `controlled-io`, which follows the completed step, before checking the count. Add a negative control delaying retry progress after wrapper entry.
